known_gaps.notes: Dispatch intercept, park reason, event payload and phase tool surface landed. The DM accept path still does not compact the source into a colony queen seed (separate open gap).
known_gaps.title: suggest_colony has no Go dispatch/intercept

known_gaps.notes: The colony phase now exposes new_colony and the agentloop intercept/pending-pivot/event path landed. The lean-handoff accept endpoint is still 501 (separate open gap).
known_gaps.title: task_create(new_colony=true) pivot has no production Go handler

known_gaps.notes: Accepting a colony-phase pivot currently returns 501. Upstream builds a sibling colony from goal/handoff/tasks, with no transcript copy, no compaction and no spawn lock.
known_gaps.title: colony pivot accept (lean-handoff sibling colony) is not implemented

known_gaps.notes: Go creates metadata/worker.json and a fresh colony session only; upstream copytree's the queen session and schedules a background compaction into an inherited seed. Memories are not copied on either side (queen-scope memories stay shared).
known_gaps.title: DM fork into a colony does not copy/compact the source session

known_gaps.notes: Worker surface now discovers framework/preset/user plus queen and colony scopes, with colony overriding same-name lower scopes.
known_gaps.title: colony worker skill catalog missed framework/user scopes

known_gaps.notes: Role-default preset skills are applied when building the worker catalog.
known_gaps.title: queen profile default_preset_skills not wired into worker catalog

known_gaps.notes: The loop now computes the upstream payload and the session bus subscription runs one long reflection; proactive microcompaction emits nothing.
known_gaps.title: compaction did not publish context_compacted / run long reflection

known_gaps.notes: Go MemoryRouteDeps only carries Home; no SchedulePush seam and no cloud-sync implementation is wired. Upstream only pushes global/ and agents/queens/ paths via _maybe_sync_memory.
known_gaps.title: memory routes do not schedule a cloud-sync push

known_gaps.notes: The hand-maintained config-support-ledger anchor now points at writeCompactionReport(agentCtx, ratioBefore, ratioAfter, preInventory).
known_gaps.title: HIVE_COMPACTION_DEBUG ledger anchor went stale after loop split
